errors.quote: With every new thousand Freya caught her breath.
errors.wrong: "Caught her breath" means she recovered or calmed down; the original says every new thousand took her breath away.

errors.quote: Freya had already left such questions unanswered.
errors.wrong: Suggests she had ignored such questions at some earlier point; the original says that by now she simply ignored this kind of question, so she skips this one too.
